mapper.insert: INSERT INTO financial_transaction_tbl (user_id, spending_category_id, transaction_type, source_type, target_type, transaction_status, amount, created_at) VALUES (#{walletId}, 1, 'CHARGE', 'ACCOUNT', 'WALLET', 'SUCCESS', #{amount}, NOW())

INSERT INTO financial_transaction_tbl (user_id, receive_id, spending_category_id, transaction_type, source_type, target_type, transaction_status, amount, created_at) VALUES (#{walletId}, #{receiverId}, 1, 'TRANSFER', 'WALLET', #{receiverType}, 'SUCCESS', #{amount}, NOW())

INSERT INTO feed_tbl (user_id, target_id, feed_type, content, visibility, feed_status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{transactionId}, #{feedType}, #{content}, #{visibility}, 'ACTIVE', NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT bank_code AS bankCode, bank_name AS bankName FROM bank_tbl ORDER BY bank_code ASC

SELECT a.bank_code AS bankCode, COALESCE(b.bank_name, 'KB국민은행') AS bankName, a.account_number AS accountNumber, a.owner_name AS ownerName, a.created_at AS lastTransferAt FROM account_dummy_tbl a LEFT JOIN bank_tbl b ON a.bank_code = b.bank_code WHERE a.user_id != #{userId} ORDER BY a.account_id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
